children: Apple (AAPL) shares climbed about 2% in morning trading Wednesday after reports pointed to a new smart-home product lineup that could expand the company's presence beyond its existing home devices.

The centerpiece is a new home hub that Apple is expected to introduce on Oct. 13. The device reportedly will feature a roughly six-inch display and can either sit on a countertop or be mounted on a wall.
The hub is designed to bring home controls, media and communications into one device. It is also expected to use facial or voice recognition to tailor information for individual household members.

Apple is also reportedly preparing an updated HomePod mini and a new Apple TV. Both products are expected to retain their current designs while receiving faster processors aimed at supporting newer Siri AI capabilities.

The broader push would give Apple a more dedicated presence in the smart-home market, where Amazon and Google already offer established products. Apple has not immediately confirmed the reported launch plans.

title: Why Apple Stock Is Climbing Today
